versions.changelog:
debtop-collateral-check v1.0.1

- Added detailed usage instructions, boundaries, and compliance requirements in SKILL.md for end users.
- Clarified capabilities: read-only search, no registration or configuration needed, and which public debt notice tools are available.
- Explained guest token self-bootstrapping process and requirement for explicit user consent before on-device credential creation.
- Provided operational guidance for tool selection, error handling, and rate limiting.
- Outlined structured output expectations for collateral search results, emphasizing non-inference and attachment of original notice links.
- Documented differences from adjacent skills and when to use each.
